meta.name: Sundermere
meta.subtitle: A Continent of the Sundered West
meta.note: x,y are canvas pixels matching sundermere-map.svg viewBox 0 0 2520 1764

realms.name: Ardennia
realms.government: Feudal kingdom under a boy-king and a fractious regency
realms.ruler: King Aldric IV, aged eleven; Lord Regent Sevrin Maur
realms.peoples: Humans, with old-blood halfling farm clans in the downs
realms.hook: The last unbroken fragment of the Ardent Empire. Its armies are still the finest on the continent and its treasury is empty.

realms.name: Thrail
realms.fullName: The Free Cities of the Thrail
realms.government: Merchant concord of seven chartered cities; no standing army
realms.ruler: The Seven Syndics, elected annually and bribed continuously
realms.peoples: Everyone. Thrail asks no one's blood, only their tariff.
realms.hook: Whoever holds the isthmus holds the continent. Thrail holds it by owing everyone money.

realms.name: Ordrane
realms.government: Centralised kingdom with a powerful knightly order, the Iron Wake
realms.peoples: Humans; large half-orc population in the border marches
realms.hook: The rising power. Ordrane has spent thirty years buying what Ardennia inherited, and is nearly finished.

realms.name: Sylvarien
realms.ruler: Coronal Ithren Vaelas, in the eleventh century of her reign
realms.peoples: Elves, half-elves, and the wood-gnomes of the lower vales
realms.hook: Sylvarien remembers the cataclysm that made the Sundering. It has never told anyone what it was.

realms.name: The Ythan League
realms.fullName: The Free League of the Ythan Mere
realms.government: Trade league of lake-ports; a fleet instead of an army
realms.ruler: Mistress of the Mere, Halvia Corr
realms.peoples: Humans and river-folk; a large gnomish artificer quarter in Lathmere
realms.hook: Controls every barge on the inland sea. Its charter is older than any crown and it enforces it with grain prices.

realms.name: Drennmark
realms.government: Waning monarchy; real power sits with the Grey Wardens of the pine-marches
realms.peoples: Humans of the northern forest; scattered lycanthropic bloodlines
realms.hook: Something in the Wyrdpines has been moving south for six years. The Wardens have stopped reporting it.

realms.name: Karrun-Deep
realms.government: Confederation of nine delving holds; each hold sovereign below ground
realms.ruler: The Nine Thanes, sitting as the Deepmoot
realms.peoples: Dwarves; human surface-tenants in the valley towns
realms.hook: Three of the nine holds have gone silent. The Deepmoot has voted, six to nothing, not to discuss it.

realms.name: Hjaldmark
realms.government: Clan-holds bound by oath to a High Jarl; oaths renewed each midwinter
realms.peoples: Humans of the frozen coasts; goliath clans in the high fells
realms.hook: Hjaldmark longships have started raiding Ardennia again. Not for gold. They are looking for something.

realms.name: Sarathal
realms.government: Divine monarchy; the Sun-Throne claims descent from a dead god
realms.peoples: Humans of the deep south; dragonborn caste of the Ember Legion
realms.hook: Sarathal's god has been dead a thousand years. Two years ago, its temples began answering prayers again.
